summary.scope: Complete staged result for this finite read suite. The approved missing-readable-memory ERROR class counts as expected; not all ERROR classes do. Primary universal verification is reused separately.

metrics.timing_scope: Sum of measured sequential stage work, including failed proof compilation attempts. Human/chat proof authoring time was not measured; this is not a full elapsed authoring-to-completion measurement.
metrics.sharing_policy: Shared ITP helper/kernel work counted once, not multiplied by 12 cases; no artificial per-case allocation.

itp_stage.shared_stages: Shared helper compilation, failed authoring attempts and independent kernel replay are counted once in aggregate metrics.
